dev.emem/observed_latency.note: measured here over recent calls, not a budget

annotations.title: k-NN over the corpus by embedding

as_of_signed_at.description: Bi-temporal transaction-time bound (RFC 3339). Also applied to candidates BEFORE cosine. Same Lance-bypass note as as_of_tslot.

as_of_tslot.description: Bi-temporal valid-time bound. Applied to candidate cells BEFORE cosine scoring, a cell with no fact whose tslot ≤ as_of_tslot under the scoring band is dropped from the candidate pool (undecidable→drop). When set, the Lance ANN fast-path is bypassed (the index has no signed_at column); brute-force k-NN runs instead so as_of is honoured truthfully.

band.description: vector band to scan (default: 128-D Tessera foundation embedding). For mode=hamming/hamming_then_rerank you can pass either the cosine band (e.g. 'geotessera') or its binary sibling ('geotessera.bin128'), the responder picks the right one.

filter.description: Claim-algebra predicate evaluated against every candidate before ranking. A cell with no fact for the filter's band is DROPPED rather than treated as false, so 'places like X where NDVI > 0.5' never silently includes cells with no NDVI.

key.description: cell64 (look up that cell's vector) or 'inline:[x,y,...]' literal vector

mode.description: Scoring mode. cosine = fp32 over full vector (precise, ~256 B/cell scan). hamming = sign-bit popcount over the binary sibling band (~16 B/cell, ~1000× faster, ~65% recall@10). hamming_then_rerank = triage with Hamming on 4·k candidates then re-rank by cosine, matches cosine precision at ~16× less work.

scope.description: Multi-tenant scope `{user_id, agent_id, run_id, org_id}`. Setting it bypasses the ANN index entirely, because that index carries no scope column, and runs the brute-force scan instead: the tenant filter is honoured truthfully, and the call is slower.
